component.name: Sifter
component.summary: Every game on your PC in one honest launcher

description.p: Sifter is the trust layer for your game library: it finds every game installed on your PC — Steam, and on Linux also Heroic (Epic/GOG) and Lutris — scores how aggressively each one's monetisation is designed (Design Risk), how much players actually enjoy it (Joy Index), and whether it respects your time, then launches anything with one click.

On Linux, Windows titles launch through Valve's Proton via Steam, and every Steam game carries an honest compatibility badge from a bundled snapshot of ProtonDB community reports, anti-cheat support status, and Valve's official Deck Verified rating — including "Blocked by anti-cheat" when a game simply will not run, shown before you press Play, never after.
Free, no account required to scan and score your library. Sifter never charges you, and money never moves a score.
